title: Promotions API
description: The Promotions API lets merchants run marketing campaigns that are shown to customers across their stores and terminals — for example on a terminal’s idle screen or printed on a receipt. A promotion defines what is displayed (its visual assets), when it runs (its schedule), and how it rewards customers: either a promo code that applies a discount at checkout or a redirect link that sends customers to a destination. After it is created, a promotion is assigned to one or more stores and synced to their terminals to go live, and it keeps running within its schedule until it expires or its budget or redemption limits are reached.

apis.heading: Create Promotion
apis.description: Creates a new promotion for a merchant. Set `promoType` to choose the mechanism — a promo code that discounts a customer’s order, or a redirect link that sends customers to a destination — then define the schedule, the visual assets shown to customers, and any eligibility, redemption, and usage rules. A newly created promotion is not yet visible to customers: assign it to one or more stores and sync it to their terminals to make it live. The promotion type is fixed once the promotion is created.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: The unique identifier of the merchant the promotion belongs to.

reqParams.name: name
reqParams.description: A name used to identify the promotion in the dashboard.

reqParams.name: promoType
reqParams.description: The promotion mechanism. This is fixed at creation and cannot be changed later.

possibleValues.description: A discount the customer redeems with a code, configured in `promoCode`.
Sends the customer to a destination URL, configured in `redirectLink`.

reqParams.name: schedule
reqParams.description: The window during which the promotion runs.

reqParams.name: startTime
reqParams.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the promotion becomes active.

reqParams.name: endTime
reqParams.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the promotion ends.

reqParams.name: visualAssets
reqParams.description: The content shown to customers for the promotion. Each item’s `type` determines which of the fields below apply.

reqParams.name: type
reqParams.description: The kind of asset.

possibleValues.description: Text content, shown using `headline`, `subheadline`, and `body`.
An image, shown using `url`.
A video, shown using `url`.
A button, shown using `buttonText` and `buttonUrl`.

reqParams.name: headline
reqParams.description: The primary line of a TEXT asset.

reqParams.name: subheadline
reqParams.description: The secondary line of a TEXT asset.

reqParams.name: body
reqParams.description: The body copy of a TEXT asset.

reqParams.name: url
reqParams.description: The public URL of an IMAGE or VIDEO asset.

reqParams.name: buttonText
reqParams.description: The label shown on a BUTTON asset.

reqParams.name: buttonUrl
reqParams.description: The URL a BUTTON asset opens when tapped.

reqParams.name: promoCode
reqParams.description: The discount configuration for a promo-code promotion.

reqParams.name: code
reqParams.description: The code a customer enters at checkout to redeem the offer (for example, SAVE20).

reqParams.name: offer
reqParams.description: How much the code discounts.

reqParams.name: type
reqParams.description: Whether the discount is a percentage or a fixed amount.

possibleValues.description: A percentage discount, set by `percentage`.
A fixed-value discount, set by `amount`.

reqParams.name: percentage
reqParams.description: The percentage discount to apply (0–100).

reqParams.name: amount
reqParams.description: The fixed discount amount, in the smallest currency unit (for example, 10 SEK is 1000).

reqParams.name: budget
reqParams.description: The spend limit for the promo code.

reqParams.name: maxAmount
reqParams.description: The maximum total discount the promotion may give away, in the smallest currency unit. When reached, the promotion stops automatically with status BUDGET_DEPLETED.

reqParams.name: redirectLink
reqParams.description: The redirect destination for a redirect-link promotion.

reqParams.name: url
reqParams.description: The destination the customer is taken to.

reqParams.name: assignmentRules
reqParams.description: Conditions an order must satisfy for a customer to be eligible for the promotion.

reqParams.name: minimumOrderAmount
reqParams.description: The minimum order total required, in the smallest currency unit.

reqParams.name: itemPresentInOrder
reqParams.description: The order must contain at least one of these item IDs.

reqParams.name: categoryPresentInOrder
reqParams.description: The order must contain at least one item from these category IDs.

reqParams.name: redemptionRules
reqParams.description: Conditions that must be met at checkout before the discount is applied.

reqParams.name: minimumOrderAmount
reqParams.description: The minimum order total required, in the smallest currency unit.

reqParams.name: itemPresentInOrder
reqParams.description: The order must contain at least one of these item IDs.

reqParams.name: categoryPresentInOrder
reqParams.description: The order must contain at least one item from these category IDs.

reqParams.name: usageLimits
reqParams.description: Limits on how many times the promotion can be redeemed.

reqParams.name: maximumRedemptions
reqParams.description: The total number of redemptions allowed across all customers. Once reached, the promotion stops with status ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED.

reqParams.name: maximumRedemptionsPerCustomer
reqParams.description: The number of redemptions allowed per individual customer (for example, 1 for a one-time offer).

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Indicates whether the request succeeded — either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: promotionId
resParams.description: The identifier of the new promotion. Use it to fetch, update, assign, sync, or delete the promotion.

apis.heading: Update Promotion
apis.note: The promotion type (`promoType`) is fixed at creation and cannot be changed here — to change it, delete the promotion and create a new one.
apis.description: Updates an existing promotion. Only the fields included in the request are changed; any omitted field is left as it was. Updated content is then synced to the terminals where the promotion is displayed.

apis.heading: Delete Promotion
apis.description: Permanently deletes a promotion. It is removed from every store it was assigned to and can no longer be displayed or redeemed. This action cannot be undone.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: The unique identifier of the merchant the promotion belongs to.

reqParams.name: promotionId
reqParams.description: The promotion to delete.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Indicates whether the request succeeded — either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

apis.heading: Fetch Promotion by ID
apis.description: Returns the full configuration of a single promotion — its schedule, visual assets, discount or redirect details, rules, and current status. The promotion is returned inside the `data` array.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: The unique identifier of the merchant the promotion belongs to.

reqParams.name: promotionId
reqParams.description: The promotion to retrieve.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Indicates whether the request succeeded — either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: promotionId
resParams.description: The unique identifier of the promotion.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: The current lifecycle state of the promotion.

possibleValues.description: Currently running — within its schedule, with budget and redemption limits remaining.
Created but not yet started (its start time is in the future).
Manually switched off by the merchant.
Past its end time.
Stopped because spend reached the promo code budget.
Stopped because the redemption limit was reached.
A discount the customer redeems with a code, configured in `promoCode`.
Sends the customer to a destination URL, configured in `redirectLink`.

apis.heading: Fetch Promotions
apis.note: Results are paginated. The total number of promotions and the current page are returned in the `x-total-items` and `x-page-number` response headers.
apis.description: Returns a paginated list of the merchant’s promotions with their full configuration and current store/terminal assignments. Optionally filter by status, for example to show only ACTIVE promotions.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: The unique identifier of the merchant whose promotions are listed.

reqParams.name: status
reqParams.description: Returns only promotions in this state. Omit to return promotions of any status.

reqParams.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1.

reqParams.name: pageSize
reqParams.description: The number of promotions per page. Defaults to 100.
